# Concepts

This chapter outlines several concepts that are encountered within statistics.

## Definitions

### Endpoints

An endpoint is a patient-level quantity for which there is one value per
patient. It can be derived from a single observation or measurement per patient,
or it can be a composite endpoint. An example can be the occurrence of a
cardiovascular event, which is defined as the occurrence of a stroke, a
myocardial infarction, or another cardiovascular event.
